_comment: Free-form placement rules. Buildable ground is a GRID of cells: those within max_distance_from_path start unlocked, and the rest can be bought with Capital, but only orthogonally adjacent to ground already owned - so expansion spreads outward from the road rather than letting you claim an unrelated corner. min_distance_from_path keeps turrets off the road and its walls (corridor half-width 23 + wall 10 = 33). min_platform_spacing stops an infinite stack of turrets on one spot. cell_cost_step makes each purchase dearer than the last, so buying ground stays a real trade against buying turrets.
_premium: Premium ground: a handful of authored cells per map that make the turret standing on them better. Scarce on purpose - 'who gets the hill' is the opening decision of a board, and at the fork the good tiles do not split evenly.
